title: Pick Out JSON
story: The bazaar lists its sellers as JSON. jq lets you pull out just one field.
goal: Find the name of the first seller and report it.
hints: Pipe the response into jq. The first item is .[0].

Run:
curl -s http://api.bazaar.local/sellers | jq -r '.[0].name'
Then answer: Lakshmi
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
